target: Hong et al. 2025, DOI 10.1063/5.0263346; numerical outcomes not yet extracted or read in this development turn.
known_target_metadata: Title, authors, year, approximate T=11±1 C and RH=56±2%; no collection-efficiency outcomes used.
source_of_parameters: Published equations and physical constants, no fit performed to collection outcomes.
development_data: Jones2022 and its ancestral calibration datasets
eligibility: All extractable individual-drop collection measurements in Hong2025; include all reported particle/drop size combinations. Distinguish actual observations from paper model curves. If no numerical table, digitize visible measured markers with explicit axis calibration and uncertainty; do not select on model agreement.
matching: Use reported physical in-chamber size, density, T, RH, P and speed. If aerodynamic size, convert with slip and density; do not apply water uptake twice. Missing P=101325 Pa, missing speed=Beard, unknown GSD primary=1 with 1.3/1.5 sensitivities, unknown k_p=.43 with .1/1/3 sensitivities. Number vs mass average follows measurement method. Non-neutral/unreported charges, unmatched humidity, missing distribution, nonterminal drops and Re>800 rear are explicit qualifications.
primary: Sum brownian, finite interception, S42 corrected impaction, Jones Eq12 rear within Re20--800, signed Depee-style surface phoretic flux, clipped at zero only with flag. All assumed sticking probability=1.
scores: All-row predicted/observed ratios, geometric bias, median absolute factor error, fraction within factor 2. These are descriptive scores, not a universal validation criterion. Report measured uncertainty and digitization separately. Never re-tune after outcome reveal.
sensitivity: Reported T/RH/size uncertainty if available; speed ±10%, density ±10%, GSD 1/1.3/1.5, k_p .1/.43/1/3; sensitivity envelopes are not confidence intervals.
numerics: Deterministic algebraic closure: no stochastic seeds or trajectory timestep. Quadrature refinement eps 1e-5/1e-8. Independent author-code Brownian/interception/rear benchmarks and closed inventory conservation. No claim of grid-resolved CFD.
source_audit: Jones archived impaction code uses Re_radius whereas S42 uses Re_diameter; main Eq8 says .172 but supplement S42 and code say .173. Use S42. Thermophoresis S50/code mixes thermal-conductivity and length terms dimensionally; use prior Depee force with correct particle Kn and parameterized material conductivity. Independent benchmarking excludes discrepant components.
